name: limit_section_outside_the_view
why: ENTRY GT4, the limit. `CreateSectionViewAt5` does not take the cut in its signature: it takes it from the LINE selected on the sheet. A line that falls outside the view produces an empty section — and the view is counted, looks good, and shows nothing. No error would say so.
_what_changes_compared_to_the_twin: One argument: `end_mm`. The twin passes it as **0**, that is it cuts through the middle; here it is **9999**, which on a view a few tens of sheet millimetres wide is outside everything. Same operation, same arguments, same drawing, same part — it is the VALUE that changes, not which argument is passed.
_why_the_twin_passes_offset_mm_even_if_i: The first draft did not pass it, and the bench answered **fake twin: it has not even one argument in common with the refusal, they are two operations that do not talk to each other**. It was right, and the rule is written in this very field two lines above: if the two calls share no argument, the refusal does not show that the check on `end_mm` works — it only shows that two different calls do different things. The value 0 is the default, so the twin behaves as before: what changes is that now it SAYS it.
defect_caught: That the check on the cut disappears. It is a guard that is written once and never seen to fire: the day it stopped working, the empty sections would come back «done», and an empty section view on a workshop drawing is worse than a missing section — it is there, so nobody looks for it.
_why_the_message_must_carry_the_numbers: «The cut falls outside» alone does not say by how much: whoever reads does not know whether they were wrong by a millimetre or by ten centimetres. The message names the value asked for and the good interval, which is the difference between a refusal that is corrected and one that is retried at random.

expect.why: same part as the twin up to the step that changes
the same cavity as the twin: if the two started from different geometries they would not be a pair
the part must be on disk before the view names it
the refusal must be the one on the CUT, not the one on «it is not a drawing»: without this expectation a refusal for the wrong reason would pass for a good one
and not the one on «there is nothing to section» either: the view is there, and it is the cut that is wrong
